latestLiveFollow.fixtureConstraint: Bounded follow course with an embedded GameTest player and an ordinary unaddressed Chinese chat message; not the formal Actor/Observer gate.

latestLiveSurpriseDefense.actions: Local emergency survival reacted to contact and the body killed the visible zombie with ordinary combat actions.
latestLiveSurpriseDefense.fixtureConstraint: One visible fixture zombie; no random hostile population or Hardcore statistic.

latestLiveDirectionalDamageRecovery.decision: REPLAN during emergency recovery; local engage_observed_entity counterattack
latestLiveDirectionalDamageRecovery.actions: The first real run killed the body while it only scanned a rear Zombie. After the production fix, the fair directional damage cue caused a bounded sneak separation, the body reacquired and attacked through vanilla, survived, and triggered Monster Hunter.
latestLiveDirectionalDamageRecovery.fixtureConstraint: One controlled rear Zombie and a bounded warning scenario; the model request and emergency lane are both exercised, but this is not a model-only, PVP, horde, Hardcore, random-seed, or M4 statistic.

latestLiveCombat.actions: A Chinese player chat reached the server; the live model response was schema/revision accepted; the body rejoined through the initial-anchor lifecycle, used owned iron equipment, moved and attacked through the vanilla combat lane, and triggered Monster Hunter. SQLite recorded the causal chain through low_level_actions_issued.
latestLiveCombat.fixtureConstraint: One visible controlled Zombie and owned equipment; not a PVP, horde, Hardcore, random-seed, or M4 statistic.
latestLiveCombat.supersededFailure: run-live-zombie-20260814c placed the embedded human at the world origin and was stopped before chat delivery; it is retained as a fixture failure, not a product pass.

latestLiveHordeDefense.actions: A Chinese team chat reached the server; the first model response replanned, then HTTP-200 START_SKILL output passed schema/revision validation; SQLite recorded skill_started and low_level_actions_issued. After the normal first-human anchor transaction, the clean authored six-target arena produced four damaged Zombies/Skeletons, body movement, and full body health.
latestLiveHordeDefense.fixtureConstraint: Six controlled visible mobs (three Zombies, three Skeletons), not the formal ten-plus-ten PVP/horde, Hardcore, random-seed, or M4 statistic.
latestLiveHordeDefense.supersededFailure: The earlier 45.39-second clean run is retained; the latest rerun uses the same causal attribution after the target recreation fix and passed with four of six targets damaged. Earlier ambient/slime and stale-anchor runs remain negative evidence.

latestLiveTenPlusTenHorde.actions: A Chinese request to protect the player from ten Zombies and ten Skeletons reached the real model; HTTP-200 output passed schema/revision validation, SQLite recorded skill_started and low_level_actions_issued, and the causal evidence counted 16 of 20 authored targets damaged after the skill entered RUNNING. The body moved and remained at full health; the fixture threshold is 10 damaged targets.
latestLiveTenPlusTenHorde.fixtureConstraint: Twenty controlled visible mobs (ten Zombies, ten Skeletons), owned iron equipment, and a bounded arena; not human PVP, Hardcore, random-seed, or M4 evidence.
supersededFailures: The previous 38.28-second rerun counted all 20 authored targets and remains valid controlled evidence, but it is not the latest measurement.
Earlier runs counted target death flags or ambient damage before model skill start and are explicitly superseded.
A pre-recreation run lost all authored targets during the first-human body relogin and correctly failed with no visible hostile evidence.

latestLiveIronGolemDuel.actions: A Chinese player request reached the real model; HTTP-200 output passed schema and revision validation, selected engage_observed_entity, and started the vanilla skill. SQLite recorded low_level_actions_issued attack_entity. The fixture enforced genuine survival abilities; the body moved, damaged the golem, received a real golem attack while surviving, and the GameTest passed.
latestLiveIronGolemDuel.fixtureConstraint: One controlled visible iron golem with owned iron equipment; not PVP against a human, Hardcore, random-seed, ten-plus-ten horde, or M4 statistic.
latestLiveIronGolemDuel.supersededFailure: Three earlier authorized attempts remain negative evidence: the body moved and damaged the golem but no incoming golem attack was observed. The root fixture defect was stale creative/invulnerability state, not a model success.

latestLiveGoldenApple.actions: The body consumed the owned golden apple through the vanilla item-use path and passed the food-consumption integrity checks.
latestLiveGoldenApple.fixtureConstraint: Owned fixture inventory and bounded food goal; not a general inventory policy claim.
